core.title: Hand Forged Beaded Hook, Acorn AM9BP

text.description_html:
Acorn AM9BP, Hand Forged Beaded Colonial Hook

A hook such as this one can be useful in any room. Hang up towels, light weight bags, necklaces, or even the dog's leash with the functional yet beautiful Hand Forged Beaded Hook. It has a smooth, matte black iron finish for a rustic touch that makes it great for traditional and historic homes as well as ranches and and homes with southwest decor; and it comes packaged with mounting screw.

Features and Specifications of the Hand Forged Beaded Hook:

  • Finish: Smooth Black Iron
  • Material: Iron
  • Length: 3-1/2"

Sold Individually. Package includes: 1 hook and mounting screw.
